qa_pairs.question: Do C++ compilers on Linux systems typically include their own implementation of the C++ Standard Library?
qa_pairs.answer: No, many C++ compilers under Linux do not provide their own implementation of the C++ Standard Library; instead, they use one that is normally installed on the system.

qa_pairs.question: Which C++ Standard Library is commonly utilized by compilers on Linux systems?
qa_pairs.answer: Compilers on Linux systems typically use `libstdc++`, which is distributed with GCC, as their C++ Standard Library implementation.
